cases.brief: Explain a schematic shaft coupling: separated input/output, collar engagement, linked rotation, then a readable hold. Use genuine Three.js; label it as a schematic, not a reconstruction of a real product. No narration, captions or external assets.
observe: Input, collar and output have independent motion
Camera ends on the coupling relationship, not a generic spinning primitive

cases.brief: From separately approved supplied photograph and two supplied documents, explain their supplied chronological relationship. Preserve existing captions exactly, reserve their band, introduce the documents separately and carry a document edge into the next shot. Do not invent facts or generate replacement assets.
observe: Supplied content drives the scene rather than generic decoration
Adjacent shots have an intentional handoff

observe: The marker stays attached to the compared samples

cases.brief: Explain a queue with three jobs and one worker: arrival, waiting, processing, completion. Each job keeps its identity and moves only when its state changes. Use measured or explicitly supplied timing, not invented narration cues. No external assets.
observe: Only one job is processed at a time
Motion explains state rather than decorating a title

cases.brief: Explain a schematic positive-displacement pump: chamber expansion with inlet open, pause with both valves closed, contraction with outlet open, then hold. No external assets or quantitative engineering claims. Keep the relevant valve visible at each action phase.
observe: Flow follows the open valve only
Both causal phases have separate inspection samples
Portrait framing preserves labels and complete mechanism

cases.brief: Compare two separately approved registered photographs of the same subject. Keep their scale and position matched; move a comparison boundary to expose the second state, then hold both states. Preserve supplied labels; do not invent causal or authenticity claims.
observe: Subject registration remains fixed during wipe
Both actual images are visible at the hold
Missing assets are not silently generated
